column1: # Every clip is the same Forge map (empty floor, player spawned at the center),
# the same mode, and the same armor. Exactly one player action differs per clip,
# This helps isolate action-dependent fields; incidental state and timing can
# also differ, so byte changes still need independent structural checks.
# The two groups differ only in how the match ended:
#   force-end    match manually ended at ~10s of gameplay, action performed at 5s
#   natural-end  1-minute mode time limit expired, action performed at 10s
# A 10-second time limit turned out not to be settable, so the natural-end matches
# run the full minute. Both groups share an identical ~16s load period and an
# identical 14s post-game tail; see FILM_FORMAT.md for the measured phase map.
